title: RLC 串联电路：分电压可以大于总电压
statement: RLC 串联电路接在正弦电压源 U_s = 100∠0° V（有效值）上，ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 6 Ω，L = 16 mH，C = 125 µF。
求电流 I 的有效值、电感电压 U_L 和电容电压 U_C 的有效值，并判断电路的性质。

questions.explain: U_L = X_L·I = 16 × 10 = 160 V——比电源电压 100 V 还大。
U_C = X_C·I = 8 × 10 = 80 V。U_L 与 U_C 反相，相量相加时部分抵消：U_L − U_C = 80 V。

questions.ask: 电路呈什么性质？为什么 U_L = 160 V 可以大于电源电压 100 V？
choices: 感性；KVL 是相量相加，U_L 与 U_C 反相相互抵消，有效值不能直接相加
容性；因为 U_C 小于 U_L
感性；这说明计算有误，分电压不可能超过总电压
questions.explain: X = X_L − X_C = 8 Ω > 0，电路呈感性，电压超前电流 53.13°。相量 KVL：U_s = U_R + U_L + U_C，其中 U_L、U_C 方向相反，所以 |U_s| = √(60² + (160 − 80)²) = 100 V。

hints: 先求 X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC)，再写 Z = R + j(X_L − X_C)。
I = U/|Z|，各元件电压有效值 U_R = RI、U_L = X_L·I、U_C = X_C·I。
solution: **5. 验算（相量 KVL）。** U_R 与 I 同相，U_L 超前 I 90°，U_C 滞后 I 90°：|U_s| = √(U_R² + (U_L − U_C)²) = √(60² + 80²) = 100 V ✓。

en.title: Series RLC: a part voltage can exceed the total
statement: A series RLC circuit is driven by the sinusoidal source U_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 6 Ω, L = 16 mH, C = 125 µF.
Find the rms current I, the rms inductor voltage U_L and the rms capacitor voltage U_C, and decide whether the circuit is inductive or capacitive.

questions.explain: U_L = X_L·I = 16 × 10 = 160 V — larger than the 100 V source.
U_C = X_C·I = 8 × 10 = 80 V. U_L and U_C are in antiphase, so they partly cancel in the phasor sum: U_L − U_C = 80 V.

questions.ask: I_s the circuit inductive or capacitive, and how can U_L = 160 V exceed the 100 V source?
choices: Inductive; KVL adds phasors — U_L and U_C are in antiphase and cancel, so rms values do not add
Capacitive, because U_C is smaller than U_L
Inductive; it means the calculation is wrong, a part voltage can never exceed the total
questions.explain: X = X_L − X_C = 8 Ω > 0, so the circuit is inductive and the voltage leads the current by 53.13°. Phasor KVL: U_s = U_R + U_L + U_C with U_L and U_C pointing in opposite directions, so |U_s| = √(60² + (160 − 80)²) = 100 V.

hints: First find X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC), then Z = R + j(X_L − X_C).
I = U/|Z|; the rms element voltages are U_R = RI, U_L = X_L·I, U_C = X_C·I.
solution: **5. Check (phasor KVL).** U_R is in phase with I, U_L leads I by 90°, U_C lags I by 90°: |U_s| = √(U_R² + (U_L − U_C)²) = √(60² + 80²) = 100 V ✓.
X_L > X_C, so the circuit is **inductive**.
